risks: Comando que reinicia/desliga a maquina: del "%ProgramData%\Microsoft\Diagnosis\ETLLogs\AutoLogger\DiagTrack*"
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /timeout 10

playbooks.name: Atom Playbook
playbooks.author: Project Atom
playbooks.description: Strip Windows to the best possible. Lowest CPU, RAM and disk usage.

risks: Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set disabledynamictick yes  <Performance (Configuration/Tasks/05-performance.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /deletevalue useplatformclock  <Performance (Configuration/Tasks/05-performance.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set {current} nx optin  <Performance (Configuration/Tasks/05-performance.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set {current} recoveryenabled no  <Performance (Configuration/Tasks/05-performance.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set {current} disableelamdrivers yes  <Performance (Configuration/Tasks/05-performance.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set bootmenupolicy Legacy  <Performance (Configuration/Tasks/05-performance.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set {current} hypervisorlaunchtype off  <Performance (Configuration/Tasks/05-performance.yml)>
Comando que remove tarefas agendadas: schtasks /Delete /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\AppxAllUserStore\UScheduler" /F 2>nul  <Final (Configuration/Tasks/10-final.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set disabledynamictick yes  <Gaming (Configuration/Tasks/12-gaming.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set useplatformtick yes  <Gaming (Configuration/Tasks/12-gaming.yml)>
Comando que modifica dados de boot: bcdedit /set tscsyncpolicy enhanced  <Gaming (Configuration/Tasks/12-gaming.yml)>
